summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a non-binding memorandum of understanding to acquire 100% of Aquila Hash, Inc. No terms (price, premium) are stated. The MOU provides for a 60-day mutual due diligence and exclusivity period, with definitive terms to be negotiated. The board has not yet recommended, and no advisor is named. The transaction may be structured as stock-for-stock. As a non-binding preliminary agreement, completion is uncertain. Watch for execution of a definitive agreement within the due diligence period.
